title: Explicit coefficient map into an ordered Cech total and its identities
statement: For a scheme X, a finite open family V, an O_X-module sheaf F, a cochain complex G and a cochain map e:F[0] → G, construct beta:L(V,F) → Tot(V,G) [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex] by beta^n=L(e^0)^n followed by inclusion of the (n,0) summand. Its components satisfy the cochain identity. This map is natural in pairs of coefficient and complex maps commuting with e in degree zero, and the two composites from Gamma(X,F) in degree zero agree. For e equal to the identity of F[0], beta is an isomorphism. No cover, boundedness, flasqueness, or quasi-isomorphism hypothesis is required. The category of module sheaves is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: The horizontal cochain identity is naturality of the Cech differential. The extra vertical differential term is zero since e is a cochain map from a single complex. This constructs the stated map.
Check naturality on each summand using total-inclusion naturality and the augmentation identity; check degree-zero agreement using naturality of restriction of global sections.

For a single coefficient complex, all summands with second degree nonzero vanish. The total-descending map selecting the remaining summand is an inverse in each degree, proving the complex map is an isomorphism.
